rato_segurado.subject: A single mature male grey rat seen from the front, held up in the air by the scruff of its neck in a plain steel gauntlet that reaches in from the right edge. Its head is raised, its belly faces us, and its four pink limbs are stretched wide apart like a starfish, with its hind legs spread far apart. Between the spread hind legs hang two big round bulging pink testicles in a large hairless pink sac, as big as the rat's head, bare and fully in view in the lower center. Its long pink tail hangs down behind the sac.
